== Walkthrough ==

Talk to either [[Shakrn Meadowgreen]] (160, -2217) or [[Ulan Meadowgreen]] (126, -2177) in [[Southern Karana]].

* Shakrn: Vambraces, Boots, Gauntlets, Helmet
* Ulan: Pauldron, Greaves, Bracer, Breastplate

For each armor piece you'll need to collect the following items.
==[[Shakrn Meadowgreen]]==
{{CheckboxList}}

'''{{:Crafted Vambraces}}'''
* [[Fire Emerald]] (2)
* [[Griffon Eye]] ([[Northern Karana]] - [[a Griffon]] (level 35), [[Grimfeather]] (lvl 37))
<br>
'''{{:Crafted Plate Boots}}'''
* [[Sapphire]] (2)
* [[Goblin Frost Totem]] ([[Permafrost]] - a Goblin Patriarch (lvl 27-33 mob))
<br>
'''{{:Crafted Gauntlets}}'''

* [[Aviak Charm]] ([[Southern Karana]] - [[Aviak avocet]] (lvl 28-30 mob))
<br>

* [[Ruby]]
* [[Goblin Fire Totem]] ([[Solusek's Eye]] (A) - [[Fire goblin shaman]] Lvl 24, [[inferno goblin shaman]] Lvl 28)
